title: Settings Maintenance Operator Center and Update Release Closeout Hardening
summary: Completes the Settings Maintenance operator center with truthful update apply states, backup manager actions, explainable diagnostics, repeatable update checks and hardened release closeout identity verification.
changelog: Makes Settings Maintenance update apply states truthful when failed, stalled, reconnecting or check_failed states are present.
Adds a unified backup manager flow for create, check, delete and clear restore-status boundaries.
Improves diagnostics and support-report actions with explainable warnings and stable operator UI.
Removes manual update-check repeat throttling while preserving concurrent check de-duplication.
Preserves real GitHub release title and summary text in Settings Maintenance instead of replacing it with locale fallbacks.
Hardens update apply release identity verification so API-visible complete-but-wrong-commit identity cannot be accepted.
Adds release-cycle closeout identity sync and explicit update status validation after GitHub Release publication.
